description: HTML source for a web-based database visualizer interface, including styles and scripts for browsing databases, tables, and displaying data with dynamic fetching and UI interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading the data from API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders fetched table data into an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cell, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated view.
